systems.name: 6.1 Story Mode / Arcade Mode
systems.notes: Implement a full arcade run with cutscenes, boss encounters, and ending. Multiple routes based on choices.

systems.name: 6.2 Survival & Boss Rush Modes
systems.notes: Endless survival mode with increasing difficulty and boss rush mode for speedrunners.

systems.name: 6.3 Unlockables & Progression
systems.notes: Add unlockable characters, palette swaps, and cheats tied to achievements.
